name: Arts & Entertainment
summary: Help audiences discover performances, creative work, events, and venues through useful search pages and clear ticket journeys.
challenge: Events and programmes change quickly. Weak event pages and unclear schedules make discovery and booking harder.

name: Automotive
summary: Help vehicle shoppers find the right inventory, dealership, or service centre when they’re ready to compare options.
challenge: Inventory changes quickly. When listings expire without a clear next step or dealership pages lack local details, shoppers can end up on unavailable vehicles or competing listings.
focus: Indexable vehicle inventory and category pages
Paths from model searches to test drives and enquiries

name: Ecommerce
summary: Make product and collection pages easier to discover across Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom stores.
challenge: Filters, variants, and duplicate URLs can compete with the category and product pages you want customers to find. Generic descriptions also make it harder for shoppers to compare products confidently.
focus: Product structured data and internal linking

name: Education
summary: Help prospective students find and compare courses, qualifications, and admissions requirements.
challenge: Students search by subject, qualification, format, and location. Course pages that omit dates, entry criteria, or delivery format can lose enquiries even when they attract relevant traffic.
focus: Internal linking across faculties and course catalogues

name: Finance
summary: Make financial services easier to discover with clear product pages, transparent information, and content reviewed by your specialists.
challenge: People compare financial products carefully. If eligibility, fees, and service information are difficult to find, prospective customers may leave before they understand the offer.
focus: Search intent for financial products and services

name: Food & Beverages
summary: Make menus, locations, product ranges, reservations, and ordering options easy to discover on every screen.
challenge: Customers need accurate menus, opening hours, dietary information and ordering options before choosing where to eat or what to buy.

name: Healthcare
summary: Help patients find your practice, understand the services available, and take the next step toward an appointment.
challenge: Patients need clear answers about location, services, clinicians, and booking. Outdated practice information or thin service pages can send them back to search.
focus: Clinician-reviewed content and accessible booking paths

name: Hospitality
summary: Help guests discover your property while comparing destinations, room types, amenities, and places to stay.
challenge: Travellers often start with a destination or an occasion. When your site gives them little detail about rooms, amenities, or the surrounding area, they may do their research and book elsewhere.
focus: Local search visibility for hotels and venues
Clear paths from organic landing pages to direct booking

name: Logistics
summary: Reach shippers and procurement teams searching for freight, fulfilment, and warehousing services.
challenge: A generic logistics page may say little about the routes, facilities, or handling capabilities a buyer needs. That gap can cost you a quote request before anyone speaks with your sales team.
focus: Freight, fulfilment, and warehouse service pages

name: Manufacturing
summary: Help engineers and procurement teams find your capabilities, technical specifications, and products.
challenge: Buyers often search by material, tolerance, application, or manufacturing process. When those details are buried in PDFs or absent from the website, buyers may never reach your RFQ form.

name: Real Estate
summary: Connect buyers and tenants with relevant properties, neighbourhood guides, and local agents through organic search.
challenge: Property listings turn over quickly, but searches for neighbourhoods and property types persist. A site built entirely around individual listings can miss those ongoing discovery opportunities.
focus: Listing filters and duplicate URL management

name: SaaS
summary: Connect software buyers with useful feature, integration, and use-case pages that lead to informed trials and demos.
challenge: Generic product claims leave buyers unsure whether a platform fits their workflow or existing tools.
